audit_comment: THE DRAGON ISSUE-13 CLOSURE ROUND - the pure flip, no new ink. The issue-13 part-two box (the Arkenberg Japanese Mythos, folios 11-15) closes 2 closed / 0 open in tools/dragon_gap_report_013.md; the three-chain walk completes exactly as adjudicated - the R922 part-one pair (the Shlump da Orc giant physics article and the Jon Pickens demon generation article) and the R923 part-two chain (the Japanese Mythos). The bookkeeping pins: the two boxes and their three chains, the issue-12 report complete at 2 / 0 since R921, the issue-11 report complete at 1 / 0 since R918, the issue-10 report complete at 2 / 0 since R916, the issue-9 report complete at 1 / 0 since R913, the issue-8 report complete at 1 / 0 since R911, the issue-7 report complete at 1 / 0 since R909, the issue-6 report complete at 1 / 0 since R907, and the registry ground truth RE-MEASURED at the R922 battery line - 1313 defs loaded, 1338 base lua files, 25 never-load errors - superseding the R900-era 1311-live / 1333-base snapshot the R921 closer carried forward, the five-file growth noted never silent; the R921 fcl pins stay as landed, the historical snapshot they are. Per the Curtiss ALL-USABLE call the scoped-out ink stays scoped - the Tolkien Sorcerer Scroll commentary, the Bionic Supplement, the WARLORD corrections, the silly songs, the Stolen Sacrifice fiction, the comics, the contest rules and the Notes column - and the two slipped teasers harvest at issue 14: the Creature Contest #1 winner stats (the Jarnkung, the Cursed Crimson Crawler, the Ulik) print in TD 14.

banner.title: The Dragon issue-13 box closing round - the three-chain walk complete, the pure flip
banner.provenance: Bookkeeping only, no new ink pinned. The issue-13 walk (R922 opener part one, R923 opener part two, this flip) covered The Dragon Vol. II No. 7 (April 1978), the archive.org scan voice, single-voice - no chat-side upload cross-check exists for issue 13; the source lives in the archive.org item accessory-dragon-magazine-012, which holds issues 7-14. The transcripts ride extract/dragon/013/p001 through p032, landed at R922.
banner.sentinel: The R922 and R923 sentinel pins ride unchanged - the giant grid pounds and torso vision-resolved ladders, the quarter-ton tons and tenths materials conversions, the demon power grid, the sixteen see-below magic cells, the Aizen-Myoo and Light/Shade bar-garble armor classes, the seven hero strength fraction garbles and the two Sth-noted fighter cells all ride the -1 sentinel as-scanned, never silent. The registry ground truth re-measured at the R922 battery: 1313 loaded / 1338 base / 25 never-load, superseding the R900-era snapshot, the growth noted.
